content_text:
Hello Mr. Deakins,
I’m hoping you have the time to give me your thoughts on Camera Brands/Models. I’m currently shooting a Nikon D7100, but will be upgrading soon. Possibly a Z9 or maybe to another brand like Leica. I would like to make it a serious hobby. Very interested to know what your preferences are.
Thank you,
Tim
